panel.title: Advanced stability analyses
panel.intro: Five deterministic protocols beyond the jitter curve: numerical precision, threshold margins, retraining churn, conformal coverage, certified radius. Each runs on the reference set, with no upload or retraining of the deployed model.

numerical.title: Numerical jitter (float32 vs float64, threads)
numerical.desc: The only measurable software form of "hardware jitter": re-score in float32 vs float64 and under a single BLAS thread, count the verdicts that flip.

margin.title: Margin analysis (population at risk)
margin.desc: Distance of each verdict from the decision threshold: which share of the population any perturbation would flip first. Deterministic, no sampling.

churn.title: Retraining churn (structural instability)
churn.desc: Retrain the same model with different seeds and measure verdict disagreement: instability of the model itself, not of inference.

conformal.title: Conformal prediction (guaranteed coverage)
conformal.desc: Prediction sets/intervals with finite-sample coverage guarantee (under exchangeability): isolates statistically ambiguous verdicts to route to an analyst.

smoothing.title: Certified robustness (randomized smoothing)
smoothing.desc: Cohen et al. certificate (ICML 2019): L2 radius within which the smoothed classifier's verdict cannot change, with a Clopper-Pearson confidence bound.
